- Important files to look:
  - `x/costaking/*`
  - `x/finality/keeper/gov.go`
  - `x/finality/keeper/power_dist_change.go`
  - `x/finality/types/finality.go`
  - `x/incentive/keeper/btc_staking_gauge.go`
  - `x/incentive/keeper/finality_hooks.go`
  - `x/incentive/migrations/v2/store.go`
  - `x/incentive/module.go`
- Withdraw costaker rewards if the type is btc staker 
- Apply inflation and default parameters as mainnet
```go
BtcStakingPortion        = "0.181818182"  // incentives, 1% of 5.5%
FpPortion                = "0.013636364"  // incentives, 0.075% of 5.5%
DefaultCostakingPortion  = "0.530612245"  // co-staking, 2.35% of 5.5%
DefaultValidatorsPortion = "0.016949153"  // validators, 0.075% of 5.5%
// remainder (≈0.4524386) → distribution = 2% of 5.5%
```
> Note: incentives (BtcStakingPortion, FpPortion) goes first than
costaking values (DefaultCostakingPortion, DefaultValidatorsPortion)

Enhance testing infrastructure with integration and browser testing (#95)

* Enhance testing infrastructure with integration and browser testing

## Summary
- Add comprehensive browser testing using Web Test Runner with Puppeteer
- Add integration testing with real WebFinger servers
- Add controlled testing with mock WebFinger server
- Improve build system to properly handle UMD exports
- Reorganize test scripts for better separation of concerns

## New Testing Capabilities
- **Browser Tests**: Validate WebFinger works in actual browser environment
- **Integration Tests**: Test against real WebFinger servers like silverbucket.net
- **Controlled Tests**: Mock server for predictable testing scenarios
- **Improved Unit Tests**: Better timeout handling and error scenarios

## Technical Changes
- Install @web/test-runner and @web/test-runner-puppeteer for browser testing
- Install @esm-bundle/chai and mocha for browser-compatible assertions
- Fix build script to properly remove ES module exports from UMD build
- Add TypeScript support for test server with @types/node
- Create WebFinger test server for controlled testing scenarios

## Test Scripts Added
- `test:browser` - Run tests in actual browser environment
- `test:integration` - Test with real WebFinger servers
- `test:unit` - Run existing TypeScript/JavaScript unit tests
- `test:all` - Run complete test suite (strict mode)
- `test` - Run all tests (non-strict mode for development)

feat: user api requests to resource API (#9794)

# Which Problems Are Solved

This pull request addresses a significant gap in the user service v2
API, which currently lacks methods for managing machine users.

# How the Problems Are Solved

This PR adds new API endpoints to the user service v2 to manage machine
users including their secret, keys and personal access tokens.
Additionally, there's now a CreateUser and UpdateUser endpoints which
allow to create either a human or machine user and update them. The
existing `CreateHumanUser` endpoint has been deprecated along the
corresponding management service endpoints. For details check the
additional context section.

# Additional Context

- Closes https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/issues/9349

## More details
- API changes: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9680
- Implementation: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9763
- Tests: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9771

## Follow-ups

- Metadata: support managing user metadata using resource API
https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/10005
- Machine token type: support managing the machine token type (migrate
to new enum with zero value unspecified?)

✨ feat(cli): add generate command for text/image/video/tts/asr (#12799)

* ✨ feat(cli): add generate command for text/image/video/tts/asr

LOBE-5711

- `lh generate text <prompt>` — LLM text completion with SSE streaming
  - Supports --model (provider/model format), --system, --temperature, --pipe
- `lh generate image <prompt>` — Image generation via async task
- `lh generate video <prompt>` — Video generation via async task
- `lh generate tts <text>` — Text-to-speech (openai/microsoft/edge backends)
- `lh generate asr <file>` — Speech-to-text via OpenAI Whisper
- `lh generate status` — Check async generation task status
- `lh generate list` — List generation topics
- Add shared HTTP auth helper (api/http.ts) for webapi endpoints

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

- Text subcommand now defaults to non-streaming (use --stream to opt in)
- Text subcommand supports --json for full JSON response output
- Video subcommand uses requiredOption for --model and --provider
